note: 離岸風電的組裝出港、製造與運維港口，2026 年 9 月人工整理；每個港口附出處，服務過的風場只列有出處佐證的。
Offshore wind marshalling, manufacturing and O&M ports compiled by hand in Sep 2026; each port lists its sources, and farms served are only those a source ties to the port.

roles.foundation: 水下基礎製造 / foundation fabrication

ports.name: Port of Hastings
ports.en: Victoria's planned Renewable Energy Terminal on the 25 ha Old Tyabb Reclamation Area, to receive, store and assemble offshore wind components; construction could start in 2027 if approved.
ports.zhNote: 維多利亞州規劃在 25 公頃的 Old Tyabb 填海區興建再生能源碼頭，接收、儲放及組裝離岸風機組件；若獲核准最快 2027 年動工。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Old Tyabb Reclamation Area (planned terminal site), about 2.6 km north-east of Hastings between Long Island Point jetty and BlueScope's wharves, Western Port.

ports.name: Port Oostende (REBO heavy-weight terminal)
ports.en: REBO's 800 m heavy-weight quay is a construction base where turbine components are assembled for offshore wind farms, and every Belgian North Sea wind farm (399 turbines) is maintained from Oostende.
ports.zhNote: REBO 800 公尺重件碼頭是離岸風場風機組件的組裝施工基地，比利時北海所有風場（399 部風機）皆由奧斯坦德負責運維。
ports.coordNote: Heavy-load quay on the east bank (Oosteroever) of Oostende harbour (OSM man_made=quay); the REBO berth itself is not tagged

ports.name: Bremerhaven (ABC-Halbinsel / Container Terminal)
ports.en: Base port for Global Tech I (BLG offshore terminal, ABC peninsula) and, from 2011, Nordsee Ost (Container Terminal); the public Labradorhafen heavy-load terminal has a 1,132 m quay.
ports.zhNote: 曾為 Global Tech I（ABC 半島離岸碼頭）與 Nordsee Ost（2011 年起）的施工基地港；公共重件碼頭 Labradorhafen 岸線長 1,132 公尺。
ports.coordNote: ABC peninsula (BLG offshore terminal area) in Bremerhaven's overseas port (OSM locality node)

ports.name: Cuxhaven (Offshore Base / Siemens Gamesa nacelle plant)
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's offshore nacelle plant (opened 2018) sits on the quay; the offshore base served as base port for Nordsee One and assembled suction-bucket jackets for Borkum Riffgrund 2.
ports.zhNote: 西門子歌美颯離岸機艙廠（2018 年啟用）緊鄰碼頭；離岸基地曾是 Nordsee One 的施工基地港，並為 Borkum Riffgrund 2 組裝吸力桶式套管式基礎。
ports.coordNote: Offshore-base quay on the Elbe in front of the Siemens Gamesa nacelle plant, Cuxhaven (OSM works polygon and coastline)

ports.name: Mukran Port (Sassnitz, Rügen)
ports.en: Baltic Sea base port: its Offshore Terminal South supported construction of EnBW Baltic 2, Wikinger and Arkona, and the port offers long-term service bases.
ports.zhNote: 波羅的海的離岸風電基地港：南側離岸碼頭曾支援 EnBW Baltic 2、Wikinger 與 Arkona 施工，並提供長期服務基地。
ports.coordNote: Southern berths (LP 1–3) of Mukran Port where the Offshore Terminal South lies; the terminal is not tagged individually in OSM

ports.name: Port of Rostock (EEW SPC monopile plant)
ports.en: EEW SPC has made monopiles at the port since 2008 (over 2,600, up to 12 m diameter) with direct quay access; monopiles for Hornsea One, Kriegers Flak and half of Gemini came from Rostock.
ports.zhNote: EEW SPC 自 2008 年起在港區生產單樁（逾 2,600 支、直徑達 12 公尺）並可直接上船；Hornsea 1、Kriegers Flak 與 Gemini 半數單樁來自羅斯托克。
ports.coordNote: Rostock overseas port (Überseehafen) main basin; the EEW SPC plant with its own quay is in the port but was not located individually

ports.name: Port Esbjerg (Østhavn)
ports.en: Europe's leading offshore wind port: 23.6 GW shipped since 2001 (about 4/5 of Europe's capacity), incl. Horns Rev 1–2, DanTysk, Sandbank, Butendiek and UK farms; also a service base.
ports.zhNote: 歐洲首要離岸風電港：2001 年起出貨 23.6 GW（約歐洲裝置量五分之四），含 Horns Rev、DanTysk 等風場，亦為運維基地。
ports.coordNote: Virgokaj in the East Harbour (Østhavn), Port Esbjerg's offshore wind area (OSM quay name)

ports.name: Port of Grenaa
ports.en: Installation base for the Anholt offshore wind farm and pre-assembly/O&M port on the Kattegat; the TetraSpar floating demonstrator was assembled here.
ports.zhNote: Anholt 離岸風場的安裝基地，卡特加特海峽的預組裝與運維港；TetraSpar 浮動式示範機組亦在此組裝。
ports.coordNote: Kattegatkajen in Grenaa's North Harbour (OSM quay name); the sources do not name the exact Anholt quay

ports.name: Port of Rønne (Bornholm)
ports.en: Baltic installation port: turbines for Kriegers Flak were prepared here and loaded four at a time; it also handled Arcadis Ost 1, Baltic Eagle and Baltic Power.
ports.zhNote: 波羅的海安裝港：Kriegers Flak 風機在此預組裝、每趟裝載 4 部出海；亦處理 Arcadis Ost 1、Baltic Eagle 與 Baltic Power。
ports.coordNote: South harbour quays (Kulkajen/Skærvekajen area) of Rønne Havn; the exact offshore-wind quay is not named in the sources

ports.name: Ferrol / Fene (Navantia–Windar yard)
ports.en: Navantia's Fene shipyard, in partnership with Windar, builds monopiles (up to 12 m diameter) and jackets; Navantia Seanergies signed its first offshore wind contract in Dec 2014.
ports.zhNote: Navantia 的 Fene 船廠與 Windar 合作製造單樁（直徑達 12 公尺）與套管式基礎；Navantia Seanergies 於 2014 年 12 月簽下首份離岸風電合約。
ports.coordNote: Windar Offshore Galicia position given by Windar (Perlío pier beside the Navantia Fene shipyard)

ports.name: Port of Avilés (Windar Offshore)
ports.en: Windar has expanded its Avilés plants for offshore wind foundations since 2012; transition pieces are made at its Tadarsa Eólica T4 plant in Avilés.
ports.zhNote: Windar 自 2012 年起擴充 Avilés 廠區的離岸風電基礎產能，轉接段在 Avilés 的 Tadarsa Eólica T4 廠製造。
ports.coordNote: Windar Offshore T1 plant position given by Windar, in the Avilés port area on the ría

ports.name: Port of Bilbao (Haizea Wind, Muelle AZ-2)
ports.en: Haizea Wind's plant on the Bilbao outer harbour makes monopiles; the first Hornsea 3 monopiles (about 90 m, 1,670 t) shipped from Bilbao to Teesside in early 2026.
ports.zhNote: Haizea Wind 位於畢爾包外港的工廠生產單樁；Hornsea 3 首批單樁（約 90 公尺、1,670 噸）於 2026 年初由畢爾包運往英國 Teesworks。
ports.coordNote: Muelle AZ-2 quay in front of the Haizea Wind plant, Port of Bilbao outer harbour, Zierbena (OSM)

ports.name: Cherbourg (Quai des Flamands)
ports.en: Logistics hub where Fécamp's turbine components (blades, nacelles, tower sections) were stored from March 2023 before loading onto the installation vessel.
ports.zhNote: Fécamp 風場的風機組件（葉片、機艙、塔架段）自 2023 年 3 月起在瑟堡物流中心儲放，再裝上安裝船出海。
ports.coordNote: Quai des Flamands deep-water quay, Cherbourg (OSM quay); exact Fécamp laydown area not named in the source

ports.name: Le Havre (Quai de Bougainville)
ports.en: The 71 concrete gravity-based foundations (about 5,000 t each) for the Fécamp offshore wind farm were built in Le Havre from December 2020.
ports.zhNote: Fécamp 離岸風場的 71 座混凝土重力式基礎（每座約 5,000 噸）自 2020 年 12 月起在勒哈佛港建造。
ports.coordNote: Quai de Bougainville, Port of Le Havre (OSM quay); French Wikipedia places the Fécamp foundation yard at Bougainville

ports.name: Nantes Saint-Nazaire Port (Montoir, GE nacelle plant)
ports.en: GE's offshore nacelle and generator plant on the port opened in Dec 2014; the Saint-Nazaire wind farm was pre-assembled and installed from the port. A floating-wind assembly quay (Éole) is planned.
ports.zhNote: GE 離岸機艙與發電機工廠位於港區（2014 年 12 月啟用）；聖納澤爾風場風機由本港預組裝出海，並規劃浮動式風機組裝碼頭（Éole）。
ports.coordNote: Montoir terminal quay beside the GE (ex-Alstom) offshore nacelle/generator plant (OSM works and pier)

ports.name: Able Seaton Port (Hartlepool)
ports.en: Installation base for Hornsea One foundations (2018), Vestas turbine marshalling for Seagreen, and GE Haliade-X pre-assembly port for Dogger Bank A, B and C.
ports.zhNote: Hornsea 1 水下基礎安裝基地（2018），Seagreen 的 Vestas 風機組裝港，也是 Dogger Bank A、B、C 的 GE 風機預組裝港。
farms: Dogger Bank wind farm · B, C
ports.coordNote: Able UK quay frontage on the Seaton Channel, River Tees, east of the TERRC dry dock (OSM Able UK works / coastline)

ports.name: Belfast Harbour D1 Offshore Wind Terminal
ports.zh: 貝爾法斯特港 D1 碼頭
ports.en: UK's first purpose-built offshore wind terminal (2013): pre-assembly for West of Duddon Sands, Walney Extension and Burbo Bank Extension; leased for Mona and Morgan from 2028.
ports.zhNote: 英國首座離岸風電專用碼頭（2013），曾為 West of Duddon Sands、Walney Extension 等預組裝港；2028 年起供 Mona、Morgan 使用。
ports.coordNote: D1 quay on the County Down (east) side of Belfast Harbour, currently also the cruise berth (OSM coastline / cruise terminal)

ports.name: Great Yarmouth (Outer Harbour and river port)
ports.en: Pre-assembly/load-out port for Galloper (2017) and East Anglia ONE (2019–20); installation base for Sheringham Shoal and Lincs; O&M bases for Dudgeon, Sheringham Shoal and Scroby Sands.
ports.zhNote: Galloper、East Anglia ONE 的預組裝出港港口，Sheringham Shoal、Lincs 的安裝基地，並有 Dudgeon 等風場運維基地。
ports.coordNote: West quay of the Great Yarmouth Outer Harbour (OSM coastline); O&M bases are on the river harbour

ports.name: Green Port Hull (Alexandra Dock)
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's offshore blade factory (opened Dec 2016) and turbine load-out quay; installation base for Dudgeon, Hornsea One and Two, and Sofia.
ports.zhNote: 西門子歌美颯離岸風機葉片工廠（2016 年 12 月啟用）與風機出貨碼頭，為 Dudgeon、Hornsea 1、2 及 Sofia 的組裝港。
ports.coordNote: Siemens Gamesa riverside quay on the Humber at the south edge of the Alexandra Dock factory site (OSM works polygon/coastline)

ports.name: Montrose Port (South Quay)
ports.en: Operations and maintenance base for Seagreen (vessel operations from early 2022); an O&M base for Inch Cape has been under construction at the port since 2025.
ports.zhNote: Seagreen 離岸風場的運維基地（2022 年初起運作）；Inch Cape 的運維基地自 2025 年起於港內興建。
ports.coordNote: South Quay on the south bank of the River South Esk (Rossie Island side), where the Seagreen O&M base was built (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Aberdeen (North Harbour)
ports.en: North Harbour is the O&M base for the Aberdeen Offshore Wind Farm (EOWDC) and the Kincardine floating wind farm; the new South Harbour targets floating-wind integration.
ports.zhNote: 北港為亞伯丁離岸風場（EOWDC）與 Kincardine 浮動式風場的運維基地；新建南港鎖定浮動式風機整合作業。
ports.coordNote: North Harbour main basin (Victoria Dock); the individual O&M berths were not identified

ports.name: Port of Barrow (Ørsted West Coast Hub)
ports.en: Ørsted's West Coast Hub at the Port of Barrow runs O&M for Barrow, Walney 1&2, West of Duddon Sands and Walney Extension (about 1.5 GW).
ports.zhNote: Ørsted 西岸中心位於巴羅港，負責 Barrow、Walney 1&2、West of Duddon Sands 與 Walney Extension（約 1.5 GW）的運維。
ports.coordNote: Ramsden Dock, Port of Barrow (main basin); the exact O&M pontoon was not identified

ports.name: Port of Grimsby (Royal Dock O&M hubs)
ports.en: Large offshore wind O&M cluster: Ørsted's East Coast Hub (Hornsea 1–2, Race Bank, Lincs, Westermost Rough) and RWE's Grimsby Hub (Triton Knoll, Sofia; opened July 2025).
ports.zhNote: 大型運維聚落：Ørsted 東岸中心（Hornsea 1–2、Race Bank 等）與 RWE 格林斯比中心（Triton Knoll、Sofia，2025 年啟用）。
ports.coordNote: Ørsted East Coast Hub on the north-east side of Grimsby's Royal Dock (OSM); RWE's Grimsby Hub is also on the Royal Dock

ports.name: Port of Lowestoft (Hamilton Dock)
ports.en: O&M port for SSE's Greater Gabbard (since 2012) and ScottishPower Renewables' East Anglia ONE (30-year deal, base at Hamilton Dock); supported Galloper construction.
ports.zhNote: SSE Greater Gabbard（2012 年起）與 East Anglia ONE（Hamilton 船塢，30 年合約）的運維港，也曾支援 Galloper 施工。
ports.coordNote: Hamilton Dock, beside which ScottishPower Renewables' East Anglia O&M base sits (OSM dock); SSE's Greater Gabbard base is elsewhere in the port

ports.name: Port of Mostyn
ports.en: Construction port for seven Irish Sea wind farms incl. North Hoyle, Rhyl Flats, Gwynt y Môr, Burbo Bank, Robin Rigg and Walney 1&2; RWE's O&M hub for its Welsh farms.
ports.zhNote: 曾是 North Hoyle、Rhyl Flats、Gwynt y Môr、Burbo Bank 等七座愛爾蘭海風場的施工港，也是 RWE 威爾斯風場的運維中心。
ports.coordNote: River berth on the Dee estuary frontage of the Port of Mostyn (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Nigg (Cromarty Firth)
ports.en: Turbine pre-assembly port for Beatrice (2018), Moray East (2021) and Moray West, and foundation marshalling for Seagreen (jackets) and Moray West (transition pieces).
ports.zhNote: Beatrice（2018）、Moray East（2021）、Moray West 的風機預組裝港，也是 Seagreen 套管式基礎與 Moray West 轉接段的儲運港。
ports.coordNote: South-facing quay west of the Nigg dry dock, Nigg Energy Park (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Tyne (Dogger Bank O&M base)
ports.en: Home of the Dogger Bank Wind Farm operations and maintenance base and control room, officially opened in March 2023 and run by Equinor for all phases.
ports.zhNote: Dogger Bank 離岸風場的運維基地與控制中心，2023 年 3 月正式啟用，由 Equinor 負責營運各期風場。
farms: Dogger Bank wind farm · B, C
ports.coordNote: Port of Tyne south-bank (Tyne Dock) estate, South Shields; the exact O&M building/quay was not identified in OSM

ports.name: Teesworks – Steel River Quay (South Bank, River Tees)
ports.zh: Teesworks（蒂斯河 Steel River 碼頭）
ports.en: Steel River Quay marshals Hornsea 3 monopiles (first arrived Feb 2026). SeAH Wind's XXL monopile factory on site lost its Hornsea 3 order in Feb 2026 over factory readiness.
ports.zhNote: Steel River 碼頭為 Hornsea 3 單樁儲運組裝港（2026 年 2 月首批到港）；園區 SeAH 超大型單樁廠因產線未就緒，2026 年 2 月失去該訂單。
ports.coordNote: Midpoint of the new South Bank / Steel River Quay line on the Tees beside the SeAH monopile factory site (OSM)

ports.name: Port of Akita (Iijima)
ports.en: Base port (designated Sep 2020) leased to Akita Offshore Wind from Apr 2021; towers were pre-assembled here in 2022 for its 33 turbines in Akita and Noshiro ports.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，2021 年 4 月起租給秋田洋上風力發電，2022 年在此預組裝塔架，完成秋田港與能代港共 33 部風機。
ports.coordNote: Iijima-district base-port wharf and yard (OSM: 秋田港洋上風力発電施設建設工事拠点).

ports.name: Port of Aomori (Aburakawa)
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2024 for the Aomori Sea of Japan (South) promotion area; an Aburakawa wharf (-12 m, 230 m) is under construction from FY2024.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，服務青森縣外海日本海（南側）促進區域；油川地區碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 230 公尺）自 2024 年度起興建。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Aburakawa district shore of Aomori Port where the base-port wharf is being built.

ports.name: Port of Kashima (outer port)
ports.en: Base port designated Sep 2020; a ground-strengthened outer-port wharf (-12 m, 200 m) was built in FY2020-2024 for offshore wind installation.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，外港地區強化地耐力碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 200 公尺）於 2020 至 2024 年度興建，供離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Kashima Port harbour point near the outer-port (外港) district where the base-port wharf is.

ports.name: Port of Kitakyushu (Hibikinada)
ports.en: Base port (2020) leased to Hibiki Wind Energy, with exclusive use Oct 2024-Mar 2026 to build the 220 MW Kitakyushu Hibikinada farm; Ishikari Bay New Port's jackets were made in the port.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年指定為基地港灣，響灘東地區碼頭租給響灘風能，2024 年 10 月至 2026 年 3 月專供北九州響灘風場施工；石狩灣新港風場的套管式基礎也在北九州港製造。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Hibikinada East district base-port wharf (-10 m, 180 m), Wakamatsu ward. The Ishikari jackets were built elsewhere in Kitakyushu Port.

ports.name: Port of Niigata
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2023; a ground-strengthened -12 m wharf and berth have been under construction since FY2023 for offshore wind installation.
ports.zhNote: 2023 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，強化地耐力碼頭（水深 12 公尺）自 2023 年度起興建中，供離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Niigata East Port area (container terminal); MLIT's map places the base-port wharf in the South Wharf (南ふ頭) district, not mapped exactly.

ports.name: Port of Noshiro (Omori)
ports.en: Base port designated Sep 2020; a ground-strengthened Omori-district wharf (-10 m, 180 m) was built in FY2019-2024 for future offshore wind construction off Akita.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，大森地區強化地耐力碼頭（水深 10 公尺、長 180 公尺）於 2019 至 2024 年度興建，供秋田外海離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Omori-district base-port wharf near the Hamanasu observation deck, south side of the Noshiro Port basin.

ports.name: Port of Sakata (outer port)
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2024 for the Yuza (Yamagata) promotion area; an outer-port wharf (-12 m, 230 m) and wave barrier are under construction from FY2024.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，服務山形縣遊佐町外海促進區域；外港地區碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 230 公尺）及消波堤自 2024 年度起興建。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: outer-port (外港) district at Sakata North Port where the base-port wharf is being built.

ports.name: SK oceanplant yard, Goseong
ports.en: Korean jacket maker: jackets and piles for Taiwan's Taipower 1, Greater Changhua, Changfang-Xidao, Zhong Neng, Hai Long and Fengmiao 1, plus parts for Japan's Hibikinada and Ishikari.
ports.zhNote: 韓國主要水下基礎製造商，為台電一期、大彰化、彰芳暨西島、中能、海龍、渢妙一期製造套管式基礎與基樁，也供應日本響灘與石狩的基礎構件。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: SK oceanplant's coastal yard in the Goseong shipbuilding special zone (Naesan-ri, Donghae-myeon, Gyeongsangnam-do).

ports.name: Eemshaven
ports.en: Gemini's monopiles and transition pieces sailed out from Eemshaven, and the port remains a maintenance base for North Sea wind farms including Gemini.
ports.zhNote: Gemini 風場的單樁與轉接段自 Eemshaven 出港安裝，該港也持續作為 Gemini 等北海風場的運維基地。
ports.coordNote: Beatrixhaven, Eemshaven's main harbour basin (OSM); the specific offshore wind quay was not identified

ports.name: Port of Rotterdam – Sif Maasvlakte 2
ports.en: Sif makes monopiles at Maasvlakte 2 (and Roermond) and runs a 628 m deep-sea marshalling quay; OranjeWind's first TP-less monopile was loaded out here in Sept 2026.
ports.zhNote: Sif 在 Maasvlakte 2（及 Roermond）製造單樁，並經營 628 公尺深水組裝儲運碼頭；OranjeWind 首支免轉接段單樁於 2026 年 9 月由此出港。
ports.coordNote: Midpoint of Sif's 628 m deep-sea quay on the west side of its Maasvlakte 2 site (OSM site polygon)

ports.name: Wergeland Base (Gulen)
ports.en: Hywind Tampen's turbines were mated to their floating concrete spar foundations at Wergeland Base in Gulen before tow-out (2022–23).
ports.zhNote: Hywind Tampen 的風機在 Gulen 的 Wergeland 基地與混凝土浮動式 spar 基礎組合後拖航出海（2022–23）。
ports.coordNote: Wergeland Base site on Sløvågen, Gulen (OSM node on the base); quay not mapped separately

ports.name: Port of Łeba (Baltic Power O&M base)
ports.en: Operations and maintenance base of Baltic Power, Poland's first offshore wind farm, launched in April 2025.
ports.zhNote: 波蘭首座離岸風場 Baltic Power 的運維基地，2025 年 4 月啟用。
ports.coordNote: Baltic Power site in the port of Łeba (OSM landuse polygon)

ports.name: Anping Port
ports.en: Backup offshore wind base: wharves 10, 11, 17 and 18 leased to developers since Dec 2023 to store and load out foundations; main working port of CDWE's installation vessel Green Jade.
ports.zhNote: 離岸風電備援基地：10、11、17、18 號碼頭自 2023 年 12 月起租給開發商儲放及裝運水下基礎，也是「環海翡翠輪」的主要作業港。
ports.coordNote: North quay of the Anping commercial harbour basin, Tainan (approximate position of wharves 10-11; wharves 17-18 are also leased).

ports.name: Mailiao Port
ports.en: Formosa Heavy Industries made pin piles for Greater Changhua 1&2a at its Mailiao plant, using Mailiao Harbour for laydown and shipping to the wind farm.
ports.zhNote: 台朔重工在麥寮廠製造大彰化東南及西南第一階段的水下基樁，並以麥寮港堆置及裝船運往風場。
ports.coordNote: Mailiao Port harbour basin (Formosa Plastics' industrial port, Yunlin); Formosa Heavy Industries' pin-pile yard inside the Mailiao complex is not mapped separately.

ports.name: Port of Kaohsiung
ports.en: CSBC used Kaohsiung Harbour to assemble and store pin piles for Greater Changhua 1&2a; A6-B jacket assembly yard (wharf done 2024) and Walsin-NKT cable plant with own wharf (opened 2025).
ports.zhNote: 台船以高雄港組裝儲放大彰化第一階段基樁；洲際一期 A6-B 有洲鉅風電水下基礎組裝廠（碼頭 2024 年完工），A6-A 有華新海纜廠及專用碼頭（2025 年 12 月啟用）。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: A6 plots of the Intercontinental Container Center Phase 1 (Xiaogang) - Walsin/NKT cable plant with the A6-A cable wharf and the A6-B jacket assembly yard; exact quays not mapped.

ports.name: Port of Taichung
ports.en: Taiwan's main offshore wind hub: pre-assembly for Formosa 1-2, Taipower 1, Greater Changhua, Changfang-Xidao, Zhong Neng, Yunlin; SGRE nacelles, CS Wind towers, Tien Li blades (to 2025); Ørsted O&M.
ports.zhNote: 台灣最主要的離岸風電組裝港：海洋、海能、台電一期、大彰化、彰芳暨西島、中能、允能在此預組裝；港內有西門子歌美颯機艙廠、塔架廠、沃旭運維中心；天力葉片廠 2025 年停產。
ports.coordNote: West quay of the south basin beside Industrial Zone II (wharf #106 area; Siemens Gamesa nacelle and Tien Li blade plants behind it) - approximate. Pre-assembly also uses wharves #2, #5A/5B and #35-38.

ports.name: Port of Taipei
ports.en: Taiwan's jacket-making base: Century Wind Power's South Wharf yard built the jackets for Taipower Phase 2 (stored at Wharf S9) and 21 jackets for Hai Long 2A.
ports.zhNote: 水下基礎製造基地：世紀風電台北港南碼頭廠製造台電離岸二期的套管式基礎（存放於南 9 碼頭）及海龍 2A 的 21 座套管式基礎。
ports.coordNote: Quay of Century Wind Power's jacket yard in the South Wharf area of Taipei Port (Bali, New Taipei).

ports.name: Xingda Port
ports.en: SDMS's 27 ha jacket yard here delivered 6 jackets to Greater Changhua 1&2a and 31 to Zhong Neng (part subcontracted to SK oceanplant); SDMS quit foundation work at end-2024.
ports.zhNote: 興達海基在興達港設 27 公頃管架式水下基礎廠，交付大彰化第一階段 6 座、中能 31 座（部分委由韓國 SK oceanplant 製造）；2024 年底退出水下基礎製造。
ports.coordNote: Sing Da Marine Structure (SDMS) yard on the east side of Xingda Harbour, Qieding, Kaohsiung (approximate quay position).

ports.name: Humboldt Bay Offshore Wind Heavy Lift Marine Terminal
ports.en: Planned heavy-lift terminal at Redwood Marine Terminal I on the Samoa Peninsula to assemble and stage floating wind turbines; lost a $426.7M federal grant in 2025, draft EIR due spring 2027.
ports.zhNote: 規劃於 Samoa 半島 Redwood Marine Terminal I 建重件碼頭，組裝暫存浮動式風機；2025 年 4.267 億美元聯邦補助遭取消，環評草案預計 2027 年春公布。
ports.coordNote: Project site at Redwood Marine Terminal I on the Samoa Peninsula, from the Harbor District's 2023 CEQA notice of preparation (40°49'0.4"N, 124°10'58.7"W).

ports.name: New Bedford Marine Commerce Terminal
ports.en: Completed in 2015 as the first US port purpose-built for offshore wind; staged and pre-assembled all 62 Vineyard Wind 1 turbines (2023–2026); no new tenant as of 2026.
ports.zhNote: 2015 年完工，是美國第一座專為離岸風電興建的港口；2023–2026 年為 Vineyard Wind 1 全部 62 部風機的預組裝與出港基地，2026 年尚無新租戶。
ports.coordNote: Terminal position published by MassCEC (41°37'23"N, 70°54'50"W) for the New Bedford Marine Commerce Terminal.

ports.name: Port of Coeymans
ports.en: Hudson River port where Riggs Distler assembled 84 sets of advanced foundation components (platforms, anode cages, monopile doors) for Sunrise Wind in 2023–2026, shipped down the river.
ports.zhNote: 哈德遜河畔港口；2023–2026 年 Riggs Distler 在此組裝 Sunrise Wind 的 84 套水下基礎組件（平台、陽極籠、單樁門），經河道運出。
ports.coordNote: Port of Coeymans Hudson River frontage: project location in Carver's 2020 joint permit application (42°29'10"N, 73°47'17"W).

ports.name: Portsmouth Marine Terminal
ports.zh: 樸次茅斯港（維吉尼亞州）
ports.en: Port of Virginia terminal with a $223M, 72-acre offshore wind staging area and three heavy-lift berths; marshalling port for Dominion's 176-turbine CVOW since 2023, first power March 2026.
ports.zhNote: 維吉尼亞港務局碼頭，設 72 英畝、2.23 億美元離岸風電組裝區與 3 座重件碼頭；2023 年起為 176 部風機的 CVOW 組裝港，2026 年 3 月首度供電。
farms: Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Commercial Project
ports.coordNote: Portsmouth Marine Terminal wharf, position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 3, ch. 9 (36°51'26"N, 76°19'33"W).

ports.name: ProvPort (Port of Providence)
ports.en: GE pre-assembled Block Island Wind Farm turbine components here in 2016; Ørsted/Eversource's foundation-component hub made platforms, anode cages and doors for South Fork Wind and Revolution Wind.
ports.zhNote: 2016 年 GE 在此預組裝 Block Island 風場風機；Ørsted/Eversource 的水下基礎組件廠為 South Fork 與 Revolution 風場製作平台等組件。
ports.coordNote: ProvPort Municipal Wharf, Berths 5 and 6, position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 2, ch. 6 (41°47'25"N, 71°22'54"W).

ports.name: Salem Offshore Wind Terminal
ports.en: Planned 42-acre Crowley/MassCEC terminal on the former Salem Harbor power-plant site, designed to stage floating-wind parts; on hold after a $34M federal grant was cancelled in 2025.
ports.zhNote: Crowley 與麻州清潔能源中心規劃在 Salem Harbor 舊電廠址建 42 英畝碼頭，可暫存浮動式風機組件；2025 年 3,400 萬美元聯邦補助遭取消，計畫停滯。
ports.coordNote: Former Salem Harbor power-plant wharf, the berth of the planned terminal; position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 1, ch. 10 (42°31'27"N, 70°52'40"W).

ports.name: South Brooklyn Marine Terminal
ports.en: 73-acre Brooklyn terminal under reconstruction since 2024 as the turbine staging port and long-term O&M base of Equinor's 810 MW Empire Wind 1; turbine feeder runs planned from 2026.
ports.zhNote: 73 英畝的布魯克林碼頭，2024 年起改建為 Equinor 810 MW Empire Wind 1 的風機組裝港與長期運維基地，預計 2026 年起以駁船送出風機。
ports.coordNote: South Brooklyn Marine Terminal site (Wikipedia coordinates); marks the terminal, not a specific berth.

ports.name: State Pier, New London
ports.en: Connecticut Port Authority terminal rebuilt in 2021–23 with Ørsted and Eversource; since 2023 the turbine pre-assembly and load-out base for South Fork Wind, Revolution Wind and Sunrise Wind.
ports.zhNote: 康州港務局與Ørsted、Eversource 於 2021–23 年改建；2023 年起為 South Fork、Revolution、Sunrise 三座風場的風機預組裝與出港基地。
ports.coordNote: Central Vermont Railroad Pier (Wikipedia coordinates), which was merged with the adjacent State Pier into one heavy-lift platform in 2021–23.

ports.name: PTSC M&C fabrication yard, Vung Tau
ports.en: PTSC M&C's Vung Tau yard built the offshore substations (topsides, jackets, piles) for Hai Long 2 & 3 and four for Poland's Baltica 2, and is building one for Fengmiao.
ports.zhNote: PTSC M&C 頭頓廠製造海龍二、三號的海上變電站（上部結構、套管式基礎及基樁）與波蘭 Baltica 2 的 4 座變電站，並承建渢妙的變電站。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: PTSC petroleum service port and M&C fabrication yard on the Dinh River, Vung Tau (65A 30/4 Street, now part of Ho Chi Minh City).
